title: Brain networks tested vs. networks that matched the left-brain/right-brain myth

source.name: Nielsen JA, Zielinski BA, Ferguson MA, Lainhart JE, Anderson JS. 'An Evaluation of the Left-Brain vs. Right-Brain Hypothesis with Resting State Functional Connectivity Magnetic Resonance Imaging'

notes: The study scanned 1,011 people's resting-state brain connectivity and analyzed 7 major brain networks for evidence of a global 'left-brained/right-brained' personality dominance. It found no network showed the predicted whole-brain lateralization tied to personality type.
